Downtown / Esther Short.name: Downtown / Esther Short
Downtown / Esther Short.description: Esther Short Park and the Columbia River waterfront core with the convention center, the Waterfront Vancouver redevelopment, and the downtown Main Street retail spine.

Uptown Village.name: Uptown Village
Uptown Village.description: Main Street's historic north stretch above Esther Short with walkable shopfronts, taverns, and mixed-use infill between downtown and the Hough neighborhood.

Fruit Valley.name: Fruit Valley
Fruit Valley.description: Northwest industrial-flavored corridor along NW Fruit Valley Road with rail-adjacent warehouses, tract housing, and the western gateway to the Burnt Bridge Creek trail.

Northwest Vancouver.name: Northwest Vancouver
Northwest Vancouver.description: Established postwar single-family quadrant between NW 78th Street and the Fruit Valley road, steady remodel and addition permitting.

West Minnehaha.name: West Minnehaha
West Minnehaha.description: Minnehaha Street west-of-I-5 corridor with mid-century bungalows, small multifamily, and light commercial nodes along the state highway.

Fourth Plain / Bagley Downs.name: Fourth Plain / Bagley Downs
Fourth Plain / Bagley Downs.description: Fourth Plain Boulevard's diverse retail corridor and Bagley Downs residential grid — the metro's densest row of small-business permits and multicultural storefronts.

Maplewood.name: Maplewood
Maplewood.description: Central post-war neighborhood between Fourth Plain and Mill Plain with bungalow turnover, duplex conversions, and the NE Andresen mixed-use strip.

Walnut Grove.name: Walnut Grove
Walnut Grove.description: Northern residential belt along NE 63rd Street between I-5 and NE 112th with ranch homes, green-lot infill, and new-build subdivisions.

Burnt Bridge Creek / Image.name: Burnt Bridge Creek / Image
Burnt Bridge Creek / Image.description: Burnt Bridge Creek greenbelt neighborhoods and the Image corridor with creek-adjacent redevelopment, trail access, and steady infill permitting.

Cascade Park / First Place.name: Cascade Park / First Place
Cascade Park / First Place.description: Cascade Park retail core and First Place's master-planned subdivisions — the metro's highest-volume new-home permitting belt east of I-205.

East Mill Plain.name: East Mill Plain
East Mill Plain.description: East Mill Plain Boulevard corridor with big-box retail, garden apartments, and the SE 164th Avenue growth node at the city's east edge.

Fisher's Landing.name: Fisher's Landing
Fisher's Landing.description: SE 164th/Fisher's Landing East office-retail node with newer multifamily, medical campus employment, and Columbia River-adjacent high-value permits.

Columbia River / Northfield.name: Columbia River / Northfield
Columbia River / Northfield.description: Riverfront southern edge along SE Columbia River Way with townhome infill, marina-adjacent development, and view-lot turnover.
